items.name: mus_morning
items.text: Bright, cheerful Chinese folk theme on plucked strings: a guzheng melody with pipa, light woodblock and a small hand drum, a sunny southern market morning, a jolly food-loving old poet showing off his cooking, G major pentatonic, 112 bpm, playful and warm, it starts at once with a plucked guzheng phrase. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: mus_huangzhou
items.text: Rustic solo bamboo flute (dizi) over gentle guzheng arpeggios, a fond memory of farming a bare hillside long ago and slow-cooking pork at night, warm and nostalgic, D major pentatonic, 72 bpm. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: mus_noon
items.text: Lazy sunny noon under a lychee tree: slow plucked guzheng with a little pipa, relaxed, contented and drowsy, a little humorous, G major pentatonic, 80 bpm. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: mus_evening
items.text: Tender, warm and a little bittersweet: guzheng with a gentle erhu, golden evening light, a family packing trunks, a cheerful old man who will not be sad, F major pentatonic, 70 bpm. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: mus_cello
items.text: One single sustained solo cello note, a low D, bowed slowly with gentle vibrato, swelling and then fading away. Nothing else, no other instruments. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: mus_river
items.text: The warm guzheng theme returns, unhurried and bright: dawn on a wide river, a small boat setting off, hopeful and kind, G major pentatonic, 92 bpm. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: mus_beach
items.text: Light, cheeky island tune: plucked guzheng and pipa with a soft hand drum and a little marimba, a happy old man grilling oysters on a beach, G major pentatonic, 104 bpm. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: mus_end
items.text: One last warm phrase of a gentle guzheng theme, slow and tender, a whole life remembered with a smile, resolving to a single plucked note and then silence, G major pentatonic, 66 bpm. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.name: amb_market
items.text: A busy Chinese village morning market: vendors and buyers chattering, a rooster crowing far off, baskets, footsteps on packed earth.

items.name: sfx_cleaver
items.text: A heavy meat cleaver chopping down hard onto a thick wooden chopping block, one solid thunk.

items.name: sfx_coins
items.text: A few copper coins dropped into a palm.

items.name: sfx_whoosh
items.text: A fast whip-pan whoosh, air swish.

items.name: amb_yard
items.text: A hillside village yard in the morning: birds singing, children laughing and running nearby, a light breeze.

items.name: sfx_bubble
items.text: A clay pot gently bubbling and simmering on a small charcoal stove.

items.name: sfx_sizzle
items.text: A bone put on a hot iron grill over charcoal, meat sizzling.

items.name: sfx_dog_whine
items.text: A small dog gives one short, offended, disappointed whine.

items.name: sfx_chew
items.text: Someone gnawing and chewing on a grilled bone.

items.name: sfx_lid
items.text: Lifting a heavy clay pot lid, a ceramic clink and a puff of steam.

items.name: amb_noon
items.text: Hot southern Chinese noon: cicadas buzzing in the trees, a breeze rustling leaves.

items.name: sfx_bell_far
items.text: A single distant temple bell rung once, ringing out far across green hills.

items.name: sfx_snore
items.text: An old man snoring contentedly, slow and peaceful.

items.name: sfx_catch
items.text: A small round fruit caught in a hand, a light slap.

items.name: sfx_hooves
items.text: A horse trotting up a dirt hill road and being reined in to a stop, then a snort.

items.name: sfx_scroll
items.text: A paper scroll being unrolled.

items.name: amb_wind
items.text: A light wind over a quiet hillside, very still, nothing else.

items.name: amb_evening
items.text: A wooden house in the evening: birds settling outside, calm room tone.

items.name: sfx_brush
items.text: A Chinese ink brush writing on paper, steady strokes.

items.name: sfx_trunk
items.text: A wooden trunk lid closing gently.

items.name: sfx_hum
items.text: An old man humming a cheerful little folk tune to himself with his mouth closed, relaxed.

items.name: amb_pines
items.text: Night in a pine wood beside a lake: crickets chirping, wind in the pine needles, tiny lapping water.

items.name: sfx_lantern_set
items.text: A paper lantern set down on a stone step, a light wooden knock.

items.name: sfx_sleeve
items.text: A cloth sleeve wiping across a face, two strokes.

items.name: amb_river
items.text: Dawn on a wide river: water lapping a muddy bank, reeds rustling, early birds, a distant rooster.

items.name: sfx_oars
items.text: A wooden oar sculling in a river, rhythmic water strokes and a creak.

items.name: amb_beach
items.text: A tropical beach: surf waves rolling in, a sea breeze, palm leaves rustling.

items.name: amb_fire
items.text: A small driftwood campfire crackling on a beach.

items.name: sfx_shell_pop
items.text: An oyster shell popping open on a hot fire with a hiss.

items.name: sfx_slurp
items.text: A man slurping an oyster from its shell.

items.name: amb_temple
items.text: Inside a quiet Buddhist temple hall: a big still room, far wind chimes, stillness.

items.name: sfx_temple_bell
items.text: A deep bronze temple bell struck once, long resonant decay.

items.name: sfx_stamp
items.text: A heavy seal stamp pressed down onto paper, a solid thump.

items.name: sfx_ink_wipe
items.text: A big brush sweeping across paper, a smooth airy whoosh.

items.name: sfx_card
items.text: A paper card sliding in, a light paper rustle.
